stories.title: First Order Real Resonant Digital Filters and A Novel Orthogonal State Generator
stories.desc: We describe FOREST, a real, first order digital resonant filter and orthogonal state generator.

stories.title: A Large Envelope Can Explain Super-Puffs
stories.desc: Super-puffs are a class of exoplanets with extremely low bulk densities, having masses of a few to tens of Earth masses but radii comparable to that of Jupiter.

stories.title: Determining the Spin-down of the White Dwarf in J191213.72-441045.1 using Optical Time-Series Photometry
stories.desc: J191213.72-441045.1 (J1912-4410) is the second white dwarf pulsar to be discovered. These binary systems consist of a white dwarf primary with a cool companion and undergo pulsed emission from radio to X-ray wavelengths.

stories.title: The tangled warp of the Milky Way II: The red clump
stories.desc: The Milky Way's disc is warped in a way that varies depending on the age of the population considered. We, for the first time, trace that kinematics of the warp in red clumps stars.

stories.title: Discovery of Trailing Spiral Dust Alignment in the Dust Polarization of HL Tau at $λ= 2.1$ mm
stories.desc: Polarimetric observations of protoplanetary disks at (sub)millimeter wavelengths constrain dust grain properties, dynamics, and alignment mechanisms.

stories.title: X-ray Polarization of the Western Lobe of SS 433
stories.desc: SS 433 is a microquasar producing bipolar jets and a Pevatron candidate, known to accelerate particles to very high energies in two extended lobes.

stories.title: Comprehensive In Situ Characterization of Amorphous Solid Water Films with COSPINU2 set-up: Optical Properties, Density, Morphology, and Restructuring Dynamics
stories.desc: Amorphous solid water (ASW) dominates interstellar ice mantles, but its porosity, density, optical response, and mechanical stability depend sensitively on how the ice is grown.

stories.title: An X-ray binary origin for the LHAASO peanut
stories.desc: The LHAASO "peanut" source is a remarkably extended ($\gtrsim$4$^\circ$) ultra-high-energy gamma-ray emitter detected by the LHAASO observatory.

stories.title: A search and multi-frequency study of curved parsec-scale jets in active galaxies
stories.desc: Very long baseline interferometry (VLBI) observations show that a fraction of active galactic nucleus (AGN) jets exhibit pronounced apparent bending on parsec scales, potentially strongly enhanced by projection effects.

stories.title: Uphill Diffusion in Yukawa Plasmas
stories.desc: In a fluid mixture of many species an individual species can diffuse toward higher concentration without any external driving force because its flux is coupled to the gradients of other components.

stories.title: Exploring nonlinear body oscillations for natural quadruped gaits
stories.desc: Schmidt et al. demonstrate that nonlinear normal modes can be used to develop natural, multi-gait locomotion in a compliant quadruped robot, leveraging its inherent mechanics.

stories.title: EGMOF: efficient generation of metal-organic frameworks using a hybrid diffusion-transformer architecture
stories.desc: The authors present EGMOF, a hybrid diffusion-transformer framework that generates metal-organic frameworks with target properties through intermediate chemical descriptors, using as few as 1,000 training examples.

stories.title: Stranger Things: When Objects Appear Without Their Typical Neighbors
stories.desc: Visual context is a powerful cue for object recognition: scenes inform what, where, and at what scale objects are likely to appear.

stories.title: How Much Do Coding Agents Over-Edit, and Why? An Empirical Study of Unneeded Edits in Repository-Level Agent Patches
stories.desc: Agent patches are larger than developers', which is widely read as over-editing. But patch size does not say whether the extra edits are needed, what they are, or where they come from.

stories.title: Shape-Aware Three-Way Merge for RDF Knowledge Graphs: The schema defines the conflict: an implementation and evaluation
stories.desc: Merging RDF serializations creates ordering conflicts and misses semantic ones. We describe and evaluate a three-way merge in which the schema defines a conflict: set algebra combines canonical triples, and a slot is contended…

stories.title: A Survey of Security, Privacy, and Ethics of Large Language Models in Telecom
stories.desc: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly integrated into telecommunications for customer service, network analytics, and operational support.

stories.title: RePace: Reasoning about Demonstration Speedup for Faster Vision-Language-Action Policies
stories.desc: Since vision-language-action (VLA) policies can inherit the slow pace of human demonstrations, accelerating these demonstrations before fine-tuning can lead to faster VLA policies without an additional speed-selection module at…

stories.title: Focus Only on What's Important: Training-Free Focus Maps for Frozen Vision Transformers in Long-Video Object Segmentation
stories.desc: Vision transformers are strong but costly image encoders for video object segmentation. Training-free token merging cuts compute uniformly across the frame, including on tracked objects.

stories.title: BOP-Refer: Benchmark for Monocular 3D and 2D Object Grounding
stories.desc: We introduce BOP-Refer, the first benchmark for monocular 3D and 2D grounding of everyday and industrial objects sourced from 9 diverse BOP datasets.

stories.title: Model Weights, Airlocks and Sandboxes: A Call for Technical Validation of Re-identification Tests under the EDPB Anonymisation Guidelines
stories.desc: The Guidelines 02/2026 on anonymisation of the European Data Protection Board (EDPB), published for consultation in July 2026, assess anonymity relative to the entities that may access data.

stories.title: Dual-cation solvation-tailored electrolyte solutions for low-temperature 48-V/30-Ah lithium-ion battery modules
stories.desc: A non-aqueous electrolyte solution forms a hierarchical primary solvation sheath with a dual-Li+ inner core, enabling stable Li-based battery operation down to −50 °C across coin cells and Ah-scale modules with…

stories.title: Engineering electrolyte ion solvation structures for next-generation batteries
stories.desc: Battery performance strongly depends on the solvation structures of mobile ions within electrolytes.

stories.title: APEX: Agentic Platform for Ensemble eXploration
stories.desc: Ensemble-based methods provide a practical framework for history matching, prediction, and optimization of subsurface models. In methodological studies, however, performance is rarely assessed from a single run.

stories.title: Physics-Based TCAD Modeling of Nanowire Cryotrons with Coupled Superconducting and Thermal Dynamics
stories.desc: Nanowire cryotrons (nTrons) provide gate-controlled superconducting switching, current gain, and high-impedance outputs for cryogenic computing, detector readout, and superconductor-semiconductor interfaces.

stories.title: Butterfly Effect in Kinetic Plasma Turbulence
stories.desc: The butterfly effect is a fundamental process in chaotic systems, but it has not previously been characterized in detail for a collisionless turbulent plasma.

stories.title: Plasma Heating by Magnetic Reconnection and Alfven Waves in Collisionless Shocks
stories.desc: In collisionless shock waves, the ion and electron temperatures generally differ, and the mechanisms governing their energy partitioning remain one of the central unresolved problems in shock physics.

stories.title: Measuring the tug-of-war between two nonlinearities in a monopolar plasma vortex
stories.desc: From planetary atmospheres to magnetized plasmas, single-core vortices organize flows and transport heat and matter. Understanding their persistence requires identifying the nonlinear interactions that sustain a single core.

stories.title: Background characterization in the PIKACHU Phase 1 search for two-neutrino double-beta decay of $^{160}$Gd
stories.desc: We report a background characterization for the search for two-neutrino double-beta ($2\nu2β$) decay of $^{160}$Gd using Ce:Gd$_3$Al$_2$Ga$_3$O$_{12}$ scintillators in the PIKACHU experiment Phase 1 at the Kamioka underground laboratory. The experimental backg

stories.title: Streaming instabilities and electron transport in electron transpiration cooling
stories.desc: Electron transpiration cooling requires emitted electrons to travel through a surrounding plasma, where their relative motion with background electrons can drive streaming instabilities. We investigate these instabilities using particle-in-cell simulations wit

stories.title: Sharp Transitions of Copy Complexity in Local Certification of Typical Pure States
stories.desc: We determine the asymptotic copy complexity of $n$-qudit state certification with tensor-product measurements. For given acceptance and rejection fidelities $a$ and $b$ ($b<a$), the optimal copy complexity is $Θ(n^r)$.

stories.title: Unitary Synthesis with a Unary Tracker
stories.desc: This manuscript studies general unitary synthesis using unary-encoded ancillary register. Our first construction focuses on the $T$-cost of unitary synthesis.

stories.title: Rényi multi-entropy from Riemann surfaces
stories.desc: We compute vacuum tripartite Rényi multi-entropy in a two-dimensional compact-boson conformal field theory (CFT).

stories.title: Direct generation of N00N states with layered semiconductors
stories.desc: Photonic N00N states enable phase sensing beyond the classical limit, but their generation conventionally relies on interferometric manipulation of photons using bulk optical components.

stories.title: Experimental Quantum Hardware Benchmarks of Flat Non-Clifford Hypergraph States, Antipodal Obstructions, and Nonlocal Games on IBM Heron r2
stories.desc: Real-hardware demonstrations of quantum contextuality have reached high precision on superconducting processors, exemplified by Google Quantum AI's Mermin-Peres magic square and stabilizer games on Willow (Science, 2026).

stories.title: Slow mixing of Gibbs sampling for the quantum Curie-Weiss model
stories.desc: Hamiltonian evolution can spread local operators across a dense quantum magnet. We show that this global support does not remove the bottleneck to thermalization in the quantum Curie-Weiss model: at fixed low temperature and weak…

stories.title: Magic Moments: An Operational Approach of Certifying Nonstabilizerness from Few Copies
stories.desc: Magic is the key resource enabling universal fault-tolerant quantum computation beyond classically simulable stabilizer circuits.

stories.title: The asymptotic spectrum of tensors is connected
stories.desc: We prove path-connectedness of the asymptotic spectrum of complex tensors of every fixed order $k \geq 3$: every spectral point is connected by a path to every "one leg versus the rest" flattening rank.

stories.title: Data-enhanced self-learning projective quantum Monte Carlo with Rydberg-atom measurements
stories.desc: We introduce a data-enhanced self-learning projective quantum Monte Carlo (PQMC) method that incorporates projective measurements from programmable quantum simulators into the guiding wavefunction of a ground-state projection.

stories.title: LatentRL-QAS: Transfer via Latent Reinforcement Learning for Quantum Architecture Search
stories.desc: Reinforcement learning (RL) emerges as a prominent approach to quantum architecture search (QAS), the automated design of quantum circuits.

stories.title: Lateral photovoltaic infrared detectors with colloidal quantum dots
stories.desc: A photovoltaic device that uses HgTe colloidal quantum dot films deposited on interdigitated Au/Ti and Pt electrodes exploits asymmetric metal–Hg interactions to form lateral p–n junctions with efficient carrier…

stories.title: Control of out-of-plane anti-damping spin torque with a canted ferromagnetic spin source
stories.desc: Huang et al. show that canted magnetization in SrRuO3 generates a sizable out-of-plane damping-like torque without relying on low crystal symmetry, offering a strategy toward scalable magnetic-memory devices with…

stories.title: Origin of the anomalous shape of the $γ$-loop in paramagnetic Fe1-xCrx alloys from coupled Atomistic Spin Dynamics and ab initio Molecular Dynamics
stories.desc: The region of fcc stability in Fe-rich Fe-Cr alloys, the $γ$-loop, has an anomalous shape: at low temperatures, Cr addition initially stabilizes fcc, but above 8 at.% Cr it stabilizes bcc.

stories.title: Measuring the Roughness of Quasi-Circular Interfaces at Finite Resolution
stories.desc: Interface roughness characterizes the boundary fluctuations across different length scales, which can reveal information about a material''s pinning landscape and collective interfacial behaviour.

stories.title: Arbitrarily Weak Losses Destroy Fractal Bandstructure in Temporal Fibonacci Quasicrystals
stories.desc: Lossless photonic crystals with weak refractive index contrasts block limited frequencies.

stories.title: EGQCA Code: automated high-throughput thermodynamic modeling of solid solutions
stories.desc: Modeling disordered systems from first principles across the full composition range is a long-standing computational challenge.

stories.title: High-Throughput Orientation Extraction via Symmetry-Adapted Filters
stories.desc: An algorithm for finding the orientation of objects in an image that have a known rotational symmetry, the symmetry-adapted filter (SAF) algorithm, is presented.

stories.title: Magnetic Reconfiguration Controls Spin Splitting and Spin-Orbit-Coupled Responses in Compensated Magnets
stories.desc: Compensated magnets provide a versatile platform for spin-dependent electronic and transport phenomena.

stories.title: LetzElPhC: an electron-phonon code for efficient exciton-phonon workflows
stories.desc: We present \texttt{LetzElPhC}, an open-source software package that computes electron-phonon matrix elements from the output of density functional perturbation theory calculations performed with the \texttt{Quantum ESPRESSO}…

stories.title: Solitons as conversion events in quadratic crystals
stories.desc: In a $χ^{(2)}$ crystal with temporal walk-off and negligible dispersion, signal, idler and pump pulses obey the integrable three-wave interaction.

stories.title: DED-Agent: An agentic AI method for autonomous thermal simulation model development and calibration in laser directed energy deposition
stories.desc: In metal additive manufacturing (AM), process parameters set the local thermal history, which governs defects, microstructure and properties.

stories.title: Aqua2CAD : Observation-Guided Point Cloud Correction and Completion for CAD Reconstruction from Underwater Stereo Images
stories.desc: Recovering editable computer-aided design (CAD) models from underwater stereo images requires accurate and complete geometry, yet stereo reconstruction produces displaced points and missing regions.

stories.title: Wastewater sequencing enables scalable measles surveillance
stories.desc: Integrated clinical and wastewater monitoring during the 2024–2025 outbreaks of measles in South Africa enabled high-resolution tracking of virus spread and evolution.

stories.title: Z-TAC enables custom and combinatorial degradation of cell surface proteins
stories.desc: Cell-surface protein degraders can eliminate disease-relevant proteins, but most require custom engineering for each target.

stories.title: A long-context generative foundation model for versatile RNA design
stories.desc: Huang, Lv, Gao and colleagues investigate RNA scaling laws and introduce EVA, a long-context RNA foundation model for function prediction and diverse RNA design, supported by experimental validation.

stories.title: Tissue-wide single-cell CRISPR screening for microproteins unveils hidden layers of ribosomal complexity
stories.desc: Using an in vivo single-cell CRISPR screen, Valdivia-Francia et al. identify the pseudogene Gm10076, which encodes a microprotein identical to the ribosomal protein RPL41 and regulates ribosome biogenesis.

stories.title: Cell-autonomous inflammation in VEXAS is mediated by ERAD failure and cGAS–STING
stories.desc: Magaziner et al. describe ERAD failure in models of the inflammatory disease VEXAS with UBA1 mutation. ERAD failure arises from E2 charging defects.

stories.title: KnitNet: Learning to Search at Inference Time for Exact RNA Inverse Design
stories.desc: RNA inverse design seeks nucleotide sequences that fold into specified target structures.

stories.title: From the Deterministic Hook Effect to Stochastic Reliability in Ternary Complex Formation
stories.desc: Ternary binding systems occur in signaling, scaffold-mediated assembly, and targeted protein degradation.

stories.title: Exclusion and internal structure in the association/dissociation kinetics of DNA-binding proteins in the fast diffusion limit
stories.desc: In many canonical biophysical and biochemical contexts, complex diffusing DNA-binding proteins undergoing nonspecific adsorption and desorption can exist in different conformational states.

stories.title: Systematic study of the performance of small robots on controlled laboratory substrates
stories.desc: The design of robots able to locomote effectively over a diversity of terrain requires detailed ground interaction models;

stories.title: Using waveform types, discrete Sobolev distances, and trend compatibility to cluster short time series of clinical data
stories.desc: Clinical tests, such as the oral glucose tolerance test (OGTT), perturb a physiological system at rest and record its excursion over a fixed protocol window as a short, undersampled time series.
